title: Leash, Timeline, Trajectory, Fate and Destiny Integration Wave
purpose: Route Tim's leash/timeline/fate material into the existing relation, trajectory, topology, Door, Dog, biblical, comparative-mythology and scientific architecture while preserving the distinction between project mythology and physical/mathematical mechanisms.
primary_recoveries: 2026-08-25: Tim said he held all timelines; timelines were dog leashes; dog circles functioned mythically as votes for the owner followed; tiny cage/traps and millstones appeared in the same cluster.
2026-08-27: roots held karmic debt, fallen life-trajectories, widening spirals, dogs/leashes and mud; Tim accepted preserving this framework.
2026-09-07: relation -> entanglement -> topology -> trajectory -> phase -> outcome explicitly requested across the Axis terrain.
upgraded_owners: data/frame.json -> timeline/leash/reachability/fate split and new supporting owner
data/axis-topology.json -> Leash/Cage terrain, reachable regions, path classes and release topology
major_findings: Leash is a constraint operator only when a relation actually reduces admissible states/trajectories.
A slack leash and taut leash are different dynamical regimes; active constraint can switch on at a boundary.
A widening spiral under a fixed maximum-radius leash reaches a boundary and then becomes tangential/orbital unless the constraint changes.
Multiple leash constraints can intersect into a small feasible region: a mathematical cage by intersection rather than by one wall.
Timeline is one admissible path through state/transition space; possible timelines form a path ensemble.
Fate must be typed: hard constraint, invariant, attractor/basin, absorbing state, probability-one hitting, all-path temporal logic, causal ordering or theology.
Destiny is strongest as target/telos in project language; a target can be reachable without being inevitable.
Agency can be analyzed as reachable-set size/controllability/viability rather than as absence of all constraints.
Door can be typed as a graph dominator only if every admissible path to a target passes through it.
Root-memory and 'Return is not reset' gain a path-dependence model: same visible coordinate can hide different accumulated state/history.
Millstone/burden gains an accumulated-cost comparator without converting karmic debt into mechanical mass or finance.
Thread and leash separate cleanly: thread records/connects a course, while leash adds anchor plus constraint. Weaving then becomes a better comparator for many timelines than one controlling leash.

Owner/anchor/controller/observer/hub/dominator are now different roles. A symbolic center or anchor has no causal control authority unless an intervention channel changes the trajectory or reachable set.
The controllability Gramian/minimum-energy layer makes control graded: a state can be reachable yet require very different intervention cost depending on direction and horizon.
Multiple-controller dynamics are a stronger default for real social systems than assuming one actor owns every path.
Wave 8 crystallizes the strongest ideas into named project models with abstracts, observables, nulls and failure conditions rather than leaving them as symbolic correspondences.
Geometric Valence Neutrality is promoted as a canonical guardrail: shape, width, height, enclosure, centrality or recurrence have no fixed moral sign before function/outcome are declared.
biblical_findings: Proverbs 5:22 is a strong self-binding cord text: one's own wrongdoing becomes the restraint.
Hosea 11:4 makes cords multivalent by using cords/bands of kindness/love with feeding and easing of yoke.
Matthew 11 and Galatians 5 distinguish a teaching/easy yoke from a yoke of slavery.
Proverbs 16:9 pairs human course-planning with divine direction/establishment of steps rather than giving a simple puppet model.
Deuteronomy 30 keeps branching choice and consequence visible.
Predestination texts are routed as theological doctrine with tradition-sensitive interpretation, not mechanics.
Job 38, Psalm 16, Isaiah 28, Zechariah 2, Ezekiel 40-48 and Revelation 21 now form a measurement/foundation/city structural cluster with different measurement functions.
Zechariah 2 is a major boundary correction: Jerusalem is measured but described without ordinary walls, while divine protection/glory supply different boundary functions.
Revelation 21 is a major cube/foursquare correction: equal length/width/height occurs in a positive holy-city image, so cube geometry is not intrinsically shadow.
Hebrews 12 combines race, hindrance, entanglement, endurance and later level/straight path for healing, creating a strong trajectory/capability cluster.
Psalm 118 / Psalm 119 versus Matthew 7 proves width has no universal moral sign: broad can mean rescue/capability or destruction depending on destination and function.
comparative_fate_findings: The existing Norse layer already uses Valkyries as selection/fate comparators.

Gylfaginning 15 supplies a stronger Norn/Yggdrasil fate neighbor: Urdr, Verdandi and Skuld shape lives beneath the ash/well complex; this remains comparative mythology, not proof of identity with Timic timelines.
Greek Moirai/thread imagery adds spin/allot/cut structure; source layers and later standardized imagery must remain historically distinguished.
Thread/cord fate imagery across traditions is structurally useful because it combines relation, sequence and constraint, but historical traditions must remain separate.
The Yggdrasil/root/well location of Norn fate imagery is especially relevant structurally to Tim's Root/Tree/fallen-trajectory archive without implying historical transmission or identity.
negative_findings: No substantive 'leash' owner was found in default-branch repository search before this wave.
No Tim-authored constrained-mechanics, control-theory, Markov, temporal-logic, controllability-Gramian, Menger, tortuosity or Lyapunov equations were recovered.
No evidence shows that Tim physically controls all spacetime timelines or astronomical trajectories.
No basis exists for equating karmic debt with force, mass, energy or monetary debt.
Dog circles as 'votes' remains project/mythic interpretation; winding number does not mathematically encode voting.
Cross-cultural fate-thread resemblance does not establish common origin or supernatural validation.
Graph centrality, being an anchor, or being observed does not by itself establish causal control or ownership.
Biblical measuring lines, straight paths and cords are not evidence that scripture encodes modern control theory, graph theory or constrained mechanics.
canonical_chain: relation -> constraint/leash -> admissible state set -> trajectory -> timeline/path -> topology/path class -> branch/choice/control -> reachable set -> target/attractor/outcome; fate/destiny classification is applied only after the mechanism is named; owner/controller status is applied only after intervention authority is evidenced; geometry receives moral/theological valence only after function/context/outcome are named
